title: Constraint: AXI Burst Within a 4 KB Page
constraints: Generate AXI INCR bursts: `len` 0–15 (beats − 1) and `size` 0–2 (1, 2 or 4 bytes per beat). `addr` is aligned to the beat size.
The burst must **not cross a 4 KB boundary**: `addr % 4096 + (len + 1) · 2^size ≤ 4096`.
Corner bias: at least some bursts must end within 64 bytes of a page boundary (the interesting case).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Avoid variable shifts in constraints (`1 << size`): with Verilator, write one implication per size instead.
Constrain only the page offset `addr[11:0]`, extended to 32 bits so the sum can't wrap.
Add a helper `rand bit near_edge` with a `dist`, and an implication that pushes the address into the last 128 bytes of the page.
